notes: Raw-fetch app: no vendor SDKs. Server routes under app/api/* proxy browser requests to vendors; client platforms under app/client/platforms/* build requests to the user-configured endpoint or the app's own proxy. Shared SSE helpers (app/utils/chat.ts stream/streamWithThink fetchEventSource at 319/545) are counted at their per-platform call sites, not separately. Not counted (not LLM generation): OpenAI dashboard billing usage/subscription fetches (client/platforms/openai.ts:444,453), Baidu OAuth token (app/utils/baidu.ts:14), Edge TTS voices, ShareGPT, upstash/webdav, MCP, Tauri stream.rs generic HTTP proxy. Tests (test/*.test.ts) contain no LLM calls.
